races.name: British Stallion Studs 'Carrie Red' EBF Fillies' Nursery
races.verdict:
WONDERVISION overcame trouble in running to make a successful start to her nursery career at Wolverhampton last month and might be able to follow up with further improvement on the cards. Rollthedicebaby is fairly handicapped if recapturing the form she showed earlier in the season. Kodi Bear Light, whose stable has won this twice in recent years, is also shortlisted along with Speed of Sound and Art of Life.

  1. WONDERVISION (IRE)
  2. ROLLTHEDICEBABY (IRE)
  3. KODI BEAR LIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Weatherbys 300,000 2-Y-O Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A very big field for this valuable sales event but NIGHT IN VEGAS holds the clear edge on form and is fancied to follow up his stylish victory in the Tattersalls Stakes at Newmarket and gain a fourth success in an excellent first season. God Given Talent shaped very well on his first run for William Haggas when fourth in a York nursery and could emerge as the chief threat, although several others command respect, notably Zigazig Ah, A Bear Affair and Seven Nation Army.

  1. NIGHT IN VEGAS (IRE)
  2. GOD GIVEN TALENT (IRE)
  3. ZIGAZIG AH

races.name: Pertemps Network Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
This is wide open but it could prove worth siding with Harry Charlton's improving Dubawi colt BESIEGED who spreadeagled his field when getting off the mark at Salisbury and looks to have a fair bit more to offer now stepping into handicap company. Recent impressive York victor Stoneacre Donny rates a big threat though under a 6 lb penalty, while Irish raider Darius Dark and the unexposed Knights Charge also need considering in this highly competitive event.

  1. BESIEGED
  2. STONEACRE DONNY
  3. DARIUS DARK (IRE)

races.name: Betfred Park Hill Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' & Mares' Group 2)
races.verdict:
Although DANIELLE was behind Waardah and Consent in the Lillie Langtry at Glorious Goodwood the fast ground in Sussex was almost certainly against her and she's taken to bounce back to form with a bang. Owen Burrows' filly, who sports a first-time hood here having raced keenly at Goodwood, can fill the forecast spot.

  1. DANIELLE
  2. WAARDAH (IRE)
  3. CONSENT (IRE)

races.name: Betfred May Hill Stakes (Fillies' Group 2) (Str)
races.verdict:
Exciting prospect MUSICAL TIMES looks more than ready for this step up in class, and she's fancied to maintain her unbeaten start. Eabha has to enter calculations following an excellent second in the Prestige last time, with Scommessa Sicura, Sea of Rain and Ballyskeagh all entitled to be thereabouts.

  1. MUSICAL TIMES (IRE)
  2. EABHA (IRE)
  3. SCOMMESSA SICURA (IRE)

races.name: Meadowhall X Flannels Beauty Bar Nursery (GBBPlus Race) (Str)
races.verdict:
Karl Burke's improving WAASIL is fancied to land the hat-trick in an open-looking nursery. There could be better to come from Al Wathba (sole runner with Group entries), and he's feared most.

  1. WAASIL
  2. AL WATHBA (FR)
  3. KEEP GRATING (IRE)

races.name: East Midlands Airport And Jet2 Nursery
races.verdict:
UNDISCOVERED struggled in Group 2 company last time but he looked highly promising when winning twice at Salisbury earlier in the summer and can get back on track returned to these calmer waters. Goodwood maiden winner Rafe's Da Man is open to progress stepping in to nursery company, while wide-margin Chepstow winner Midgham Man also merits serious respect in a competitive event.

  1. UNDISCOVERED (IRE)
  2. RAFE'S DA MAN
  3. MIDGHAM MAN

races.name: Pertemps Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
ITICA proved a different proposition upped in trip when making a successful turf debut in a Goodwood seller last time and, with better still to come over further, he can make a winning start in handicaps. Devil's Peak is feared, while the bang in-form Masterinthewoods should go well again.

  1. ITICA
  2. DEVIL'S PEAK
  3. MASTERINTHEWOODS (IRE)

races.name: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Claiming Race
races.verdict:
A chance is taken on SPIRIT OF EAGLES, who's run well here previously, and has Colin Keane aboard following a significant stable switch. Ado McGuinness looks to hold a strong hand with She's Ideal and Land of The Giants, with the returning Goldrush Kid another to note.

  1. SPIRIT OF EAGLES (IRE)
  2. SHE'S IDEAL (IRE)
  3. LAND OF THE GIANTS (IRE)

races.name: Gilna's Of Laytown Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
MOYASSR could well make his second start for Ado McGuinness a winning one. Jazzit and Launch Time appeal as the most likely dangers.

  1. MOYASSR (IRE)
  2. JAZZIT
  3. LAUNCH TIME

races.name: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports (Q.R.) Handicap
races.verdict:
Plenty are in with a shout but FAOLADH rates the pick of the weights nudged up just 1 lb for his Galway success (form been franked) so gets the vote. Kitty Bear is feared most on the back of a resurgent Curragh fourth, while Minaun View and Initial Blue could also play a prominent role.

  1. FAOLADH (IRE)
  2. KITTY BEAR (IRE)
  3. MINAUN VIEW

races.name: Pride Of Place Maiden
races.verdict:
A repeat of the form KAKORI showed when narrowly denied in a claimer at Roscommon last time will probably be good enough to see her get off the mark. Sron Na Caise is next on the list ahead of Hugo's Girl.

  1. KAKORI (IRE)
  2. SRON NA CAISE (IRE)
  3. HUGO'S GIRL (IRE)

races.name: O'NEILLS.COM Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
MOVIN AND GROOVIN is taken to turn around last month's Dundalk form with Reponse Finale (second choice) and Roman Harry, a former C&D winner. Colin Keane's mount Lohengrin has also tasted success over C&D and is also respected having bounced back to form when third at Navan a fortnight ago.

  1. MOVIN AND GROOVIN (IRE)
  2. REPONSE FINALE (IRE)
  3. ROMAN HARRY (IRE)

races.name: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie (Q.R.) Handicap
races.verdict:
INDIGO DREAM is enjoying a good season and can go one place better than she did at Gowran last time. Glyndwr is also considered on the back of a solid in-frame effort at Galway, with En Or taken to complete the 1-2-3.

  1. INDIGO DREAM
  2. GLYNDWR (IRE)
  3. EN OR (FR)

races.name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
JO ARENGEOT BEY AA arrives here in decent heart and makes most appeal in a thin race. Izzy's Grey might pose the biggest threat if back to the form of his chase debut.

  1. JO ARENGEOT BEY AA (FR)
  2. IZZY'S GREY (IRE)
  3. KENZO DES BRUYERES (FR)

races.name: FBC Manby Bowdler Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
YOUDECIDE jumped and travelled with plenty of fluency when scoring at Fontwell 13 days ago and he can take the step up in grade in his stride to complete the hat-trick. Glen To Glen is much respected on the strength of his winning stable debut at Perth, whilst Karnaval Point has had a good summer and also can't be ruled out.

  1. YOUDECIDE (IRE)
  2. GLEN TO GLEN (IRE)
  3. KARNAVAL POINT (FR)

races.name: Step Into Luxury With Purple Granite Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DELULU was unlucky not to make a winning start over C&D and she can make amends at the chief of expense of dual point winner Spanish Darling, who stayed on into third in that same race. Jaunty Trooper might prove best of the rest.

  1. DELULU
  2. SPANISH DARLING (FR)
  3. JAUNTY TROOPER

races.name: CopyBet Follow Us On X Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SYTADEL has been off since winning a French maiden last spring but could be worth chancing to make a winning hurdles debut for the powerful Skelton yard. Lock Stock would be a major player if back to the form of his first 2 hurdles starts, while Action Replay is worth a look starting out for Charlie Longsdon.

  1. SYTADEL (FR)
  2. LOCK STOCK
  3. ACTION REPLAY (IRE)

races.name: PJ Nicholls KGM Korea Genuinely Made Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CRAFTY GAEL hasn't been long with the Olly Murphy yard, and he may well go one better than at this course last month. Forest Spirit is a big danger if she stays, while it's hard to rule out C&D winner Brionywells in her current vein of form.

  1. CRAFTY GAEL (IRE)
  2. FOREST SPIRIT (IRE)
  3. BRIONYWELLS

races.name: CopyBet BOG Now For Doncaster Tomorrow Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)
races.verdict:
The vote goes to interesting stable-switcher BERRY EDGE. The dangers are headed by Harry Gulliver, who looks to have returned from an absence with plenty of ability still intact, with Jessie Jump Jet and Getaway With You others to consider.

  1. BERRY EDGE (IRE)
  2. HARRY GULLIVER
  3. JESSIE JUMP JET

races.name: CopyBet BOG Now For Doncaster Tomorrow Handicap Hurdle (Div 2)
races.verdict:
This may go the way of handicap debutant BATHARA, who hasn't fully convinced with his attitude to date, but looks potentially well treated on his bumper form. It'll be no surprise to see Sean Bowen get a tune out of Traveling Soldier, and he's feared most.

  1. BATHARA (FR)
  2. TRAVELING SOLDIER (IRE)
  3. IKIGAI STAR (IRE)

races.name: Glass Times EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ASTABUEN made a pleasing debut at Newmarket last month and should have learnt plenty from that experience. He gets the nod in the opener. William Haggas's newcomer Quite Cheeky appeals on paper and needs monitoring in the market, while Desert Symphony has solid course form to her name and should also go well.

  1. ASTABUEN (FR)
  2. QUITE CHEEKY (IRE)
  3. DESERT SYMPHONY (IRE)

races.name: Flat Out Flat Glass Solutions Handicap
races.verdict:
DAPPER GUEST had a bit in hand when scoring over C&D last month and makes plenty of appeal in his follow-up bid. Cuban Lady and Silver Trumpet rate the principal dangers.

  1. DAPPER GUEST (IRE)
  2. CUBAN LADY
  3. SILVER TRUMPET

races.name: Chigwell Group - The Trade's Front Runner Handicap
races.verdict:
CARNIVAL DAY figures off a handy mark and boasts a solid record at this venue. He could be the answer to a tricky-looking contest. Beach Point and Patrol can also make their presence felt.

  1. CARNIVAL DAY (IRE)
  2. BEACH POINT (IRE)
  3. PATROL (IRE)

races.name: Quickslide Quick Ride Apprentices' Derby Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
This can go to CROOKED PATH, who has made a positive start for James Owen and can race off the same mark as when runner-up in the Amateurs' Derby here last time. Charmaine and Naval Command may provide the chief threat.

  1. CROOKED PATH (IRE)
  2. CHARMAINE
  3. NAVAL COMMAND

races.name: Under Starters Orders For Fit Show 2027 Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for CARAWAY, who remains on a handy mark and will be suited by the likely strong gallop set here. Time To Sparkle and Blue Hill head the list of dangers.

  1. CARAWAY
  2. TIME TO SPARKLE
  3. BLUE HILL

races.name: Business Pilot Handicap
races.verdict:
ROYAL BODYGUARD upped his game when scoring in decisive fashion at Newmarket last month and hasn't been harshly treated by the handicapper for that success. He may be able to score again. Eastern Veil and My Old Mate are also of interest.

  1. ROYAL BODYGUARD (IRE)
  2. EASTERN VEIL
  3. MY OLD MATE (IRE)

races.name: Feeling Flush With Emplas Handicap
races.verdict:
PLAY ME already has a couple of course victories to his name and promises to be suited by the return to this longer trip. He is the pick in an open-looking finale. OJ Lifestyle and Mr Ubiquitous should also go well.

  1. PLAY ME
  2. OJ LIFESTYLE (IRE)
  3. MR UBIQUITOUS

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Nursery
races.verdict:
HORNDEAN shaped as if ahead of his opening mark when not beaten far at Wolverhampton last month, worst affected by the trouble in the race, and he can gain compensation this time around. A pair of last-time-out winners are feared most, Sultan Darius successful on his nursery debut and the pick for second ahead of My Maria.

  1. HORNDEAN (FR)
  2. SULTAN DARIUS (IRE)
  3. MY MARIA (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MARQUESSOFANGLESEY has underperformed on his last 2 starts but this looks a thin race and he'll be the one to beat if the return to a synthetic surface pays dividends. Salvezza rates as the biggest threat.

  1. MARQUESSOFANGLESEY (IRE)
  2. SALVEZZA
  3. TIME ALONE (IRE)

races.name: Download The At The Races App Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TAKAAFUL has made a promising start to his career with 2 in-frame efforts, still green when third at Chester last month, and she looks to hold leading claims back in a maiden. The biggest threat could come from Note To Self who drops into this company for the first time, while Fully Stocked remains capable of better.

  1. TAKAAFUL
  2. NOTE TO SELF
  3. FULLY STOCKED (IRE)

races.name: Sasco Sauces Birthday Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
IN THE CITY went as close as he ever has to winning at Wolverhampton earlier in the month and a repeat could well see Warren Greatrex's 4-y-o get his head in front. He gets the marginal vote ahead of Federal Envoy, who landed a few tidy bets when making all on that same card 9 days ago and escapes a penalty. African Spirit is on a long losing run, but may fare best of the rest.

  1. IN THE CITY
  2. FEDERAL ENVOY (IRE)
  3. AFRICAN SPIRIT (IRE)

races.name: Sasco Sauces Birthday Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Preference is for MIDNIGHT'S DREAM who had been in good heart prior to his run in a higher grade here last time. He is taken to quickly get back on track and resume winning ways from his reduced mark, with Francisco next best as he returns to this shorter trip. On Key completes the shortlist.

  1. MIDNIGHT'S DREAM (IRE)
  2. FRANCISCO
  3. ON KEY

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On Instagram Handicap
races.verdict:
This can go the way of LAKE COMO, who made the frame without being seen to best effect at Kempton recently and George Boughey's charge is worth another chance to open his account for the campaign. Kaindy didn't need to advance his form to get off the mark last month and is open to improvement now handicapping, he's put forward as the main threat. Rogue Defence rounds off the shortlist.

  1. LAKE COMO (IRE)
  2. KAINDY (IRE)
  3. ROGUE DEFENCE

races.name: Sid Sims, Explosive Staging & Events Handicap
races.verdict:
LET'S GO HUGO has benefited from the refitting of cheekpieces, only narrowly denied at Newcastle in his hat-trick bid last week, so gets the vote to add to his tally. The Fixer has gone close when making the frame on his last 2 outings and could be the main danger, ahead of Pure Passion.

  1. LET'S GO HUGO (IRE)
  2. THE FIXER (IRE)
  3. PURE PASSION

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X Handicap
races.verdict:
MAKE IT UP upped his game when going down by just a head over C&D a couple of months ago and returning from a break with his stable absolutely flying, William Knight's 3-y-o is fancied to get off the mark. He faces a few in-form rivals here though, with Boston Run, Highland Harvey and Pride Eye all expected to give the selection plenty to think about.

  1. MAKE IT UP (IRE)
  2. BOSTON RUN (IRE)
  3. HIGHLAND HARVEY (IRE)

races.name: Get Raceday Ready Handicap
races.verdict:
THUNDER GODDESS is the type to improve with racing, and perhaps a further step up in trip, but she makes plenty of appeal at this level on the back of a promising second over C&D recently. Credible threats are thin on the ground but Epsom winner Private Project is certainly one of them, with Thisonesforyou worth a go over this distance.

  1. THUNDER GODDESS
  2. PRIVATE PROJECT (IRE)
  3. THISONESFORYOU

races.name: 4Racing Welcomes You Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
PISTA RESISTANCE could be a cut above these. Bellflower is a chief threat, while Madison County is interesting seeing a racecourse for the first time.

  1. PISTA RESISTANCE (SAF)
  2. BELLFLOWER (SAF)
  3. MADISON COUNTY (SAF)

races.name: Equus Champion Stayer: Holding Thumbs Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
MULHOLLAND DRIVE gets the vote. Up And Up is another who could play a big role in proceedings, while Smoking Gun is the third candidate for the three.

  1. MULHOLLAND DRIVE (SAF)
  2. UP AND UP (SAF)
  3. SMOKING GUN (SAF)

races.name: Play Soccer 6, 10 And 13 Graduation Plate
races.verdict:
HIS MAJESTY could rule. Master Spy is a big player, while Charming Cheetah has place prospects as well.

  1. HIS MAJESTY (IRE)
  2. MASTER SPY (SAF)
  3. CHARMING CHEETAH (SAF)

races.name: youcanbetonus! Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
IMYOURHUCKLEBERRY has a great chance. Midnight Show is second choice, while Wartrax Blaze is another with place prospects too.

  1. IMYOURHUCKLEBERRY (SAF)
  2. MIDNIGHT SHOW (SAF)
  3. WARTRAX BLAZE (SAF)

races.name: Tab Telebet 011 074 0300 Fm 91 Divided Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
SURPRISE PARTY should be thereabouts. Fire In Her Soul is a player, while Frangipani also demands scrutiny.

  1. SURPRISE PARTY (SAF)
  2. FIRE IN HER SOUL (SAF)
  3. FRANGIPANI (SAF)

races.name: Racing240 Fm 71 Divided Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
EIGHT HATS continues to run creditably and has fair claims. Pretty Analia might be the answer to second spot, while On A Jet Plane is prominent among those with minor place claims.

  1. EIGHT HATS (SAF)
  2. PRETTY ANALIA (SAF)
  3. ON A JET PLANE (SAF)

races.name: For Hospitality Bookings Call 011 681 1796 Mr 86 Handicap
races.verdict:
SAMUEL SHARPE just about gets the nod in this company. Golden Warrior is a sound alternative, while Euphrates is another likely to be on the premises.

  1. SAMUEL SHARPE (SAF)
  2. GOLDEN WARRIOR (SAF)
  3. EUPHRATES (SAF)

races.name: www.tab.co.za Fm 85 Divided Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
LOVE NOT WAR could be the way to go. Tempranillo is tough to ignore, while Angel's Oasis should go well too.

  1. LOVE NOT WAR (SAF)
  2. TEMPRANILLO (SAF)
  3. ANGEL'S OASIS (SAF)

races.name: Next Vaal Racemeeting Thursday 17 September Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
SERGEANT SOQRAT can win again. Time Will Tell is a threat, while Beautiful One may be the one for third.

  1. SERGEANT SOQRAT (SAF)
  2. TIME WILL TELL (SAF)
  3. BEAUTIFUL ONE (SAF)

races.name: Prix Du Parc Des Princes Handicap
Prix De La Cour Du Chemin Vert Handicap
Prix De La Rue Du Chemin Vert Handicap
Prix Du Pays De Bray - Attele
Prix De L'hippodrome Du Mont Louvet - Attele
